scientific_question: When arm/workload is block-randomized independently of global execution order and non-invasive state covariates are recorded before every cell, does the W-S non-material / W-C material total-transfer split replicate, and after nuisance-state balancing do B-A and C-B become stably identifiable?

arms.A_CANONICAL: current canonical runtime; no ANL64 plan
arms.B_PLAN_PREBOUND: exact ANL64 immutable plan prebound before timing; canonical executor choices preserved
arms.C_PLAN_PREBOUND_RESIDUAL: same prebound plan plus only residual 84 Q/K/O Q4_FAST substitutions

state_surface.collection_point: before each cell process launch and outside inference timing
state_surface.interpretation: nuisance-state balancing for the primary estimand is achieved by complete blocks plus exact ordinal-position and first-order carryover balance; state covariates are secondary diagnostics and environment validity checks, not post-hoc adjustment variables

frozen_materiality_thresholds.source: unchanged from P1R; no P2-dependent threshold tuning

block_classification_rules.plan_B_over_A_no_harm: B/A decode>=0.9 AND B/A E2E<=1.1 AND B/A TTFT<=1.1

replication_rules.stability: a pooled classification is stable only if at least 5 of 6 block-level classifications agree with it
replication_rules.W_S_total_split_replication: pooled median C/A is non-material AND at least 5/6 blocks are non-material
replication_rules.W_C_total_split_replication: pooled median C/A is material AND at least 5/6 blocks are material
replication_rules.total_TTFT_guard: pooled median C/A TTFT<=1.1 AND at least 5/6 blocks are TTFT-safe
replication_rules.plan_identifiable: for each workload, pooled B/A plan-no-harm classification has at least 5/6 block agreement
replication_rules.residual_identifiable: for each workload, pooled C/B material/non-material classification has at least 5/6 block agreement
replication_rules.decomposition_unstable: either B/A or C/B fails the 5/6 stability rule after the frozen order/carryover-balanced design

nuisance_analysis.primary: no regression/covariate correction enters primary gates
secondary: describe canonical-A variation across blocks and ordinal positions
describe association of recorded covariates with block-level performance
check whether any frozen environment invariant failed
nuisance_analysis.specific_mechanism_claim: not licensed by P3 unless a future separately preregistered mechanism study is opened
nuisance_analysis.ANL64_specific_instability_claim: not licensed by P3; instability after balancing is reported as decomposition instability without assigning mechanism

blocking_guards: exact token equality across matched A/B/C within workload
all 36 scheduled cells present for performance adjudication

stop_rules.before_cell_environment: If the exact state collector fails, any required field is missing, power scheme is not Balanced, or AC_line_status!=1, do not launch the cell; stop the entire authorized collection as ENVIRONMENT_OR_INFRASTRUCTURE_STOP.
stop_rules.completed_cell_semantic_or_structural_fa: Stop immediately; no performance interpretation and no further P3 cells under this authorization.
stop_rules.infrastructure_interruption_before_valid: Stop the entire authorized collection. No automatic retry and no resume. A new authorization may replay the full frozen P3 schedule from zero only after infrastructure adjudication.
stop_rules.valid_completed_cell: Never rerun a valid completed cell under this authorization regardless of its outcome.
stop_rules.schedule: Any schedule/order deviation stops the collection.
stop_rules.adaptive_behavior: No cooldown, delay, process cleanup, power change, threshold change, cell deletion, treatment substitution or reorder may be triggered by observed performance or covariates.

adjudication_order: G0 provenance, completeness, exact schedule and covariate-collector identity
